name: ludicrous-kill

Asset type: transparent combat popup animation sprite strip for a World of Warcraft addon.
Input images 1 and 2 are style/composition references ONLY, not edit targets. Match their existing ivory/steel heavy italic condensed wordmark family, thick black outlines, subtle metal bevel and orange ember/metallic impact effects. Render only the NEW exact wording below.

Visual direction: Arena shooter escalation level 5. Two centered lines: LUDICROUS above KILL!. White-hot molten core with incandescent white-yellow sparks, orange-red edges and blazing diagonal slashes. Maximum escalation.
